Today only the learning path calls it, and learning/learning.go:148 forces background_review, so the guard is one line of Go; bind origin 'user' to a verified person before enforce (the same shape as D2-483 for memory).

Human CRUD in capability-core writes agent_skills by direct SQL outside session-core: the POST branch writes the request's content and enabled flag (promoted_from checks visibility only), and PATCH with enabled true switches on an accepted learned skill with no content check (registry_apis.go, update branch); the row excludes human CRUD, but the owner should decide whether a person's re-enable of learned text is screened before enforce.
